title: Orthogonal projection, Gram-Schmidt, and best approximation
objectives: Compute projections by orthogonal bases and by normal equations
Prove the direct sum of a finite-dimensional subspace and its orthogonal complement
Prove Bessel's inequality and see where existence fails
prerequisites: Inner products, orthogonal sets and Gram-Schmidt (Chapter 21); projections (Chapter 17).
source_scope: The captions of the two recordings (positions 47 and 46) were read in full. The line example comes from the first; the running plane, normal equations, the infinite-dimensional counterexample, laboratory and exercises are original.
